project_info.theme: Techcombank tax-compliant business account for merchants
project_info.color_palette: Warm cream, red, black, green, wood brown

main_subject.detail: A realistic merchant banking poster set inside a Vietnamese pho shop. The Techcombank logo sits at top right. Main heading says 'Ho kinh doanh' and subheading 'Mo tai khoan chuan thue, an tam buon ban'. Four icon-led benefits read 'Khai bao don gian', 'Tuan thu dung quy dinh', 'Minh bach giao dich', and 'Kinh doanh ben vung'. At center, a smiling middle-aged female shop owner in a green shirt and dark apron holds up a smartphone showing a tax-mobile screen. A Techcombank QR stand sits on the counter in front. The restaurant background includes a menu board and the sign 'Pho Gia Truyen' with a worker preparing food. A large white bubble says 'Nhan ngay qua tang tri gia 16 TRIEU VND'. Bottom-left slogan is 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'.
main_subject.style: Trust-building merchant testimonial poster with realistic lifestyle photography, informative icon row, and clean retail-banking overlay
